title: Stone Game V
description: Divide a row of stones into two non-empty piles, discard the pile with the larger sum, and repeat. Maximize the total score.

steps.note: Initialize memoization for range [0, 2] with stones [6, 2, 3]
Split at index 0: Left [6], Right [2, 3]. Sums: 6 vs 5.
6 > 5, discard left (6), keep right (5). Score = 5 + solve(1, 2)
Split at index 1: Left [6, 2], Right [3]. Sums: 8 vs 3.
8 > 3, discard left (8), keep right (3). Score = 3 + solve(2, 2)
